// "Drop already handled" always outputs one item, so a duplicate (an empty item) still reaches "Respond 200".
const payload = $json.payload

if (!payload) return [{ json: { isDuplicate: true } }]

const { event, recipientFirstName, otherPartyFirstName, toolName, startDate, endDate } = payload
const actions = {
  requested: `asked to borrow ${toolName}`,
  approved: `approved ${toolName}`,
  declined: `declined ${toolName}`,
  cancelled: `cancelled the request for ${toolName}`,
  returned: `marked ${toolName} returned`,
}
const action = actions[event]

const message = `To ${recipientFirstName}: ${otherPartyFirstName} ${action}, ${startDate} to ${endDate}`

console.log(message)

return [{ json: { isDuplicate: false, message } }]
